verdict.rationale: MoonPay offers headless SDK methods (e.g., 'Web SDK to build fiat-to-crypto ramps with headless payments', headless Buy frame) plus a dedicated sandbox/test mode using testnet blockchains and simulated payments explicitly for integration development and testing, which supports automated, non-interactive test runs in CI. However, the core purchase/off-ramp flows still require human-facing KYC, auth, and payment challenge frames, so full end-to-end automation without any UI is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CLI tooling or documented automated test-suite examples, and confirmation that KYC/payment steps can be fully bypassed or scripted in test mode.
